preconditions.expression: all(c.isdigit() for c in stdin.split()) and len(stdin.split()) == 2
preconditions.description: stdin contains exactly two space-separated integers n and m, each between 1 and 100 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: n >= 1 and m >= 1 and n <= 100 and m <= 100
preconditions.description: n and m are integers satisfying 1 ≤ n, m ≤ 100.

postconditions.description: The first line of stdout is a non-negative integer k, representing the size of the beautiful set.

postconditions.expression: k == int(stdout.strip().splitlines()[0]) and k == len([line for line in stdout.strip().splitlines()[1:] if line.strip()])
postconditions.description: The number of points k matches the number of subsequent coordinate lines.
Each of the k subsequent lines contains exactly two space-separated integers representing coordinates (x, y).

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= int(x) <= n and 0 <= int(y) <= m and int(x) + int(y) > 0 for line in stdout.strip().splitlines()[1:] for x, y in [line.strip().split()])
postconditions.description: All points (x, y) in the output satisfy 0 ≤ x ≤ n, 0 ≤ y ≤ m, and x + y > 0.

postconditions.expression: all(not (int(x1) == int(x2) and int(y1) == int(y2)) for i in range(k) for j in range(i+1, k) for line1, line2 in [(stdout.strip().splitlines()[i+1], stdout.strip().splitlines()[j+1])] for x1, y1 in [line1.strip().split()] for x2, y2 in [line2.strip().split()])
postconditions.description: All points in the output are distinct.

postconditions.expression: all(not (int((int(x1) - int(x2))**2 + (int(y1) - int(y2))**2) == int((int(x1) - int(x2))**2 + (int(y1) - int(y2))**2)) for i in range(k) for j in range(i+1, k) for line1, line2 in [(stdout.strip().splitlines()[i+1], stdout.strip().splitlines()[j+1])] for x1, y1 in [line1.strip().split()] for x2, y2 in [line2.strip().split()])
postconditions.description: For any two distinct points (x1, y1) and (x2, y2) in the output, the squared distance ((x1-x2)² + (y1-y2)²) is not an integer, ensuring the distance is non-integer.

postconditions.expression: k == max(len(set_of_points) for set_of_points in [set()]) if not any(set_of_points) else k == max(len(set_of_points) for set_of_points in [set() for set_of_points in [set() for _ in range(10000)] if all(0 <= x <= n and 0 <= y <= m and x + y > 0 for x, y in set_of_points) and all(not (x1 == x2 and y1 == y2) for (x1, y1) in set_of_points for (x2, y2) in set_of_points) and all(not ((x1 - x2)**2 + (y1 - y2)**2 == int((x1 - x2)**2 + (y1 - y2)**2)) for (x1, y1) in set_of_points for (x2, y2) in set_of_points)])
postconditions.description: The size k of the output set is the maximum possible size of a beautiful set of points under the given constraints.
